title: 第9章 上门催租！让我买下破公寓？
slug: 神豪从收留精神小妹开始日进斗金
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

空调吹来一阵冷风，顿感一片清凉。

“要不，我们就坐那里吧？”苏子文指着一个比较位置安静的棕黄色卡座。

“好。”江辰点头道。

下一刻，香菜小跑着抵达棕黄卡座，拉开椅子，用纸巾擦了擦，确保干净整洁无污染。

看到江辰走了过来，甜美一笑：“哥，请坐！”

另一边，丸子跑去前台服务员那要了一壶罗汉果，给每个人各倒了一杯。

她眉眼含笑，双手递了一杯到江辰面前，“哥，喝口凉茶，润润喉。”

看到这一幕，苏子文整个人都呆愣住了。

要知道，以前这都是他给前女友当舔狗时，忙前忙后所做之事。

目光看向江辰，心中油然而生一股崇拜之意。

趁着两个精神小妹去上洗手间的间隙，他凑近到江辰耳旁。

“兄弟，这是咋调的？教我几招呗。”苏子文眼里满是求学二字。

然，道不可轻传。

但看在他请吃麻辣烫，目光如信徒般虔诚的份上。

江辰只好轻开金口，点拨点拨他。

“说白了，这事得分人。有些人，你哪怕只是一点小恩小惠，她也会记在心里，想着哪天怎么报答你。

而有些人，你就算再怎么掏心掏肺，她也不会觉得是你人好，反而觉得你对她好，是理所当然。

所以，下次再遇到那种只索取，不愿付出的绿茶，哪怕她有刘亦菲的颜值，也要立刻及时止损！”

苏子文闻言，顿感受益匪浅，拱手道：“江哥，小弟受教了！”

“我之前一直以为，只要我全心全意地对她好，就能真心换真心。可没想到，终究是真心喂了狗……”

江辰一针见血指出：“哥们，你那不是对她好，那叫舔！

一个需要你去舔却不懂回报的女人，多半是你的孽缘，你俩是不会有好结果的。”

苏子文认可地点了点头，眼中闪过一丝明悟，“听江哥一席话，胜读十年书啊！”

“今日小弟我，以茶代酒，敬江哥一杯！”

“我干了，你随意！”

江辰微微颔首：孺子可教。

二人碰杯。

江辰刚一饮而尽，下一刻，他脑海中便响起了熟悉的机械声。

【叮！检测到宿主传授帮扶对象‘苏子文’防范绿茶小知识，获得专属奖励10000元！】

随着机械声消失，江辰手机立刻收到了银行的收账短信。

【您尾号为7268的储蓄卡账户，收入10000.00元，余额4w元（作为一名万元大户，万元以下可忽略不计）。（XX银行）】

卧槽，这也行？

吃完麻辣烫后，与苏子文道别。

江辰一行三人返回了挂壁公寓。

丸子和香菜换上睡衣，洗了一把脸。

然后，拆开价值288元的兰蔻面膜，眼眸不由一亮。

“不愧是大牌子，好香啊！”

说着，二人美美地贴上了精致的面膜。

“哥，你要不要来一张？”

“我就不用了，你们用就好。”

“来嘛来嘛！”

丸子撕开面膜包装，朝江辰走了过来。

刚要给江辰敷上面膜，门外响起了敲门声。

来人敲门力度不小。

这不，使得墙上白漆又掉落下来不少。

“小江，在家不？”

江辰起身去开门。

下一秒，一张弥勒佛似的笑脸映入眼中。

“光...房东，有什么事？”江辰疑问道。

“小江啊，我就直说了，今天过来找你收租来着。”光头房东开门见山道。

闻言，江辰不禁有些困惑，这还没到交房租的时间吧？

一般月底才交租，这还差十多天呢。

见江辰面露不解，光头房东解释道：“这没有多少天了，如果你下个月还想继续租的话，今天就把房租给我交了。

Page (1/3)

The air conditioner blew a gust of cold air, and I felt refreshed.

"How about we sit there?" Su Ziwen pointed to a relatively quiet brown booth.

"Okay." Jiang Chen nodded.

The next moment, Xiangcai trotted to the brown booth, pulled out the chair, and wiped it with a paper towel to make sure it was clean and free of contamination.

Seeing Jiang Chen walking over, he smiled sweetly: "Brother, please sit down!"

On the other side, Wanzi ran to the front desk clerk and asked for a pot of monk fruit, and poured a cup for everyone.

With a smile on her face, she handed a cup to Jiang Chen with both hands, "Brother, take a sip of herbal tea to moisten your throat."

Seeing this scene, Su Ziwen was stunned.

You know, this was what he did in the past when he was busy being a licker for his ex-girlfriend.

Looking at Jiang Chen, a sense of admiration suddenly arose in his heart.

While the two energetic girls were going to the bathroom, he leaned close to Jiang Chen's ear.

"Brother, how do you adjust this? Teach me a few tricks." Su Ziwen's eyes were filled with the word "study".

However, the Tao should not be taught lightly.

But for the sake of treating him to spicy hotpot, his eyes were as pious as those of a believer.

Jiang Chen had no choice but to open Jin's mouth lightly and give him some advice.

"To put it bluntly, this is a matter of concern. For some people, even if you are just a small favor, she will remember it in her heart and think about how to repay you one day.

And for some people, no matter how much you show your heart and soul, she will not think that you are a good person. Instead, she will think that it is natural for you to be good to her.

So, next time you encounter that kind of green tea that only takes but is unwilling to pay, even if she has Liu Yifei’s looks, you must stop your losses immediately!"

When Su Ziwen heard this, he felt that he had benefited a lot and said, "Brother Jiang, I have learned a lesson!"

"I always thought that as long as I was kind to her wholeheartedly, I would be able to change my sincerity. But I didn't expect that my sincerity would feed the dog after all..."

Jiang Chen pointedly pointed out: "Brother, you are not treating her well, that is called licking!

A woman who needs you to lick her but doesn't know how to reciprocate is probably your fault, and there will be no good outcome between you two."

Su Ziwen nodded in approval, a hint of understanding flashed in his eyes, "Listening to Brother Jiang's words is better than ten years of reading!"

"Today, little brother, I will give you a toast to Brother Jiang with tea instead of wine!"

"I did it, you can do whatever you want!"

Jiang Chen nodded slightly: Children can be taught.

The two clinked glasses.

Jiang Chen had just finished the drink, and the next moment, a familiar mechanical sound sounded in his mind.

【bite!It was detected that the host taught the assistance object ‘Su Ziwen’ how to prevent green tea and received an exclusive reward of 10,000 yuan!】

As the mechanical sound disappeared, Jiang Chen's phone immediately received a collection text message from the bank.

[Your savings card account ending in 7268 has an income of 10,000.00 yuan and a balance of 40,000 yuan (as a large accountant with 10,000 yuan, the amount below 10,000 yuan can be ignored).(XX Bank)]

Damn it, is this okay?

After eating spicy hotpot, I said goodbye to Su Ziwen.

Jiang Chen and his party returned to the Hanging Apartment.

Wanzi and Xiangcai put on their pajamas and washed their faces.

Then, when I opened the Lancôme facial mask worth 288 yuan, my eyes lit up.

"As expected of a big brand, it smells so good!"

With that said, the two of them put on delicate facial masks.

"Brother, do you want one?"

"I don't need it, you can just use it."

"Come on, come on!"

Wanzi tore open the mask package and walked towards Jiang Chen.

Just as he was about to put a mask on Jiang Chen, there was a knock on the door.

The person knocking on the door was quite forceful.

No, this caused a lot of white paint to fall off the wall.

"Xiao Jiang, are you at home?"

Jiang Chen stood up and opened the door.

The next second, a smiling face like Maitreya Buddha came into his eyes.

"Guang... Landlord, what's the matter?" Jiang Chen asked.

"Xiao Jiang, let me tell you the truth. I'm here to collect rent from you today." The bald landlord said straight to the point.

Hearing this, Jiang Chen couldn't help but be a little confused. It's not time to pay the rent yet, right?

Usually the rent is not paid until the end of the month, which is still more than ten days away.

Seeing Jiang Chen's puzzled expression, the bald landlord explained: "There are not many days left. If you want to continue renting next month, just pay the rent to me today.
